page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i4r.32xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 128 dedicated vCPUs utilizing Intel Xeon 8369B processors running at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The system is equipped with 1024.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 8.0 GB of RAM per core.

For local storage, the instance includes 7679 GB of bundled SSD capacity. This high-capacity local storage is paired with a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps. The instance does not include any integrated GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The hardware profile offers a high density of both memory and local SSD storage relative to the 128 dedicated vCPUs. This configuration is designed for workloads requiring substantial local data persistence and high-throughput memory access. Appropriate workloads include large-scale databases, big data analytics, memory-intensive enterprise applications, and high-performance storage systems.
